'''Arlaia Zayzen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. By [[3630 BBY]] she became known as the gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]] under the title "Master of Killers". During the fights in the Arena, she used multiple droid assistants, such as [[Medical Unit AZ-01]], [[Combat Unit AZ-02]], [[Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03]], [[Assault Unit AZ-A]] and [[Assault Unit AZ-B]]. That year, Arlaia was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]," who defeated her in the first round of the Arena fights. She sustained serious injuries and while on the brink of death, her mind was downloaded into an [[Isotope-5 droid]] called the "[[Doom Droid]]." With a new, completely robotic body, Arlaia tried to claim her revenge against the Stranger, but was defeated in round nine of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arlaia Zayzen appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the first and the ninth boss of "Eternal Championship".<ref name="SWTOR" />
